propositions: The dedup key is computed from a prediction of the send-path composition rather than from the bytes actually sent, causing drift when the differ and adapter compositions diverge.
Three separately-maintained fit compositions (differ, Cloud adapter, DC adapter) must stay in lockstep to keep the dedup key correct, creating a convergence hazard.

Both mutation-enactment consumers (dispatch_one create path and dispatch_apply_phases update path) must send wire_body with a fallback to body for pre-cutover entries to prevent half the traffic from sending un-fitted bodies while keyed on fitted ones.
Re-fitting an already-fitted body must return it byte-identical across both Cloud and DC adapters so the adapter's defensive fit cannot move bytes after the key is taken.
fit_for_send derives a FittedComment with landed_text (the readback of bytes sent, matching the current dedup key) and wire_body (the pre-encode text), eliminating the prediction-vs-reality gap.
